author: Krystian Dziewa
name: KDSoftware Blazor App
description: Server and WebAssembly client projects for a Blazor Web App in which the ASP.NET Core server acts as a Backend-for-Frontend (cookie session, optional OpenID Connect, CSRF-protected API). Adds the projects to the existing solution.

Framework.description: The target framework for the projects.

auth.description: The authentication mode of the BFF.

choices.description: OpenID Connect sign-in handled by the server with a secure cookie session. Tokens never reach the browser.

centralPackageManagement.description: Whether the target solution uses central package management (package versions in Directory.Packages.props).

skipRestore.description: If specified, skips the automatic restore of the projects on create.

httpPort.description: Port number to use for the HTTP endpoint in launchSettings.json.

httpsPort.description: Port number to use for the HTTPS endpoint in launchSettings.json.

postActions.description: Add the projects to the solution. The client project is added through the server project's reference.

manualInstructions.text: Add the generated projects to your solution with 'dotnet sln add'.

Make sure Directory.Packages.props defines PackageVersion entries for: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly (10.0.12), Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server (10.0.12), Microsoft.Web.LibraryManager.Build (3.0.114)

Make sure Directory.Packages.props defines PackageVersion entries for: Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly (10.0.12), Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Authentication (10.0.12), Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.Server (10.0.12), Microsoft.AspNetCore.Authentication.OpenIdConnect (10.0.12), Microsoft.Web.LibraryManager.Build (3.0.114)

postActions.description: Restore NuGet packages required by the projects.
